dct_description_sm: The properties of water in selected freshwater streams in the watershed of Greiner Lake, near Cambridge Bay, Nunavut, has been investigated by performing pH, temperature, conductivity and total-dissolved-solids (TDS) measurements, as well as by collecting water samples that will be analyzed for isotopes in laboratory.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Freshwater quality
Health sciences and contaminants -> Water quality
dct_title_s: Preliminary Freshwater Sampling of Selected Streams in the Watershed of Greiner Lake, Cambridge Bay, Nunavut
